red_flags.quote: If Party B needs to extent the lease, should submit written application to Party A 3 months before the end of the lease. After Party A agrees, both parties will sign a new contract. If no application received during this period, Party A has the right to lease the property to others.
Party B can perform any marketing activity without Party A’s permission. But has to report to Party A to keep record.
Party B can not house anyone without identification. Party B is responsible for the fire control and safety of the property. Party A is not responsible for any damage to either host or clients.
Party B is responsible for all the sales and service in the property. Party A is not responsible for any damage.
Without Party A’s permission, Party B can not lease part or all, or exchange lease of this property.
Party A is responsible for the damage of the main structure unless damage due to Party B or its customer.

If Party B has not paid rent on time according to contract for more than 30 days, Party A has the right to terminate the contract, retake the property, and confiscate the deposit. Party B needs to compensate Party A with an amount equivalent to 3 months rent.

If can not operate due to Party A’s breach of contract, Party B has right to terminate the contract. And Party A is responsible for any damage to Party B including but not limited to renovation cost, operation loss and legal fees.
